abstract: OBJECTIVE: Prepubertal testicular tumors are rare and fundamentally distinct from adult testicular tumors. We reviewed our 11-year experience in a single medical center of China. MATERIAL AND METHODS: This study reports the clinical characteristics, histopathologic diagnosis, treatment methods, and outcome in a series of 63 prepubertal boys who were treated between 1997 and 2008. RESULTS: A total of 63 primary prepubertal testicular and paratesticular tumors were identified. The median age at presentation was 11 months. Of these tumors, 27 (42.9%) were mature teratomas, 5 (7.9%) were immature teratomas, 21 (33.3%) were yolk sac tumors, 4 (6.3%) were epidermoid cyst, 2 (3.2%) were Leydig cell tumors, 1 (1.6%) was a mixed malignant germ cell tumor, and 3 (4.8%) were paratesticular tumors. The most common clinical presentation (95.2%) was a painless scrotal mass or swelling. Forty-eight tumors were treated with radical inguinal orchiectomy, and 15, with a testis-sparing procedure. Follow-up was available in 59 cases, range from 4 to 128 months (median, 50 months). One patient with yolk sac tumor had recurrence and progression to metastasis at the end of 4 months after surgery. Other patients were disease free at last follow-up. CONCLUSIONS: Most of the prepubertal testicular lesions were benign, and the most common histologic subtype was teratoma. Our experience with testis-sparing procedures supports the current trends that less invasive treatment should be performed for benign lesions. This study confirms the excellent cure rates obtained in children with prepubertal testicular tumors.
abstract_ja:
目的：思春期前の精巣腫瘍は稀であり、成人の精巣腫瘍とは本質的に異なる。我々は中国の単一医療機関での11年間の経験を振り返った。
材料と方法：1997年から2008年の間に治療された思春期前の男児63例について、臨床的特徴、病理組織学的診断、治療法、転帰を報告する。
結果：思春期前の精巣および精巣傍腫瘍が計63例同定された。発症時の年齢中央値は11か月であった。このうち27例(42.9%)が成熟奇形腫、5例(7.9%)が未熟奇形腫、21例(33.3%)が卵黄嚢腫瘍、4例(6.3%)が類表皮嚢腫、2例(3.2%)がライディッヒ細胞腫瘍、1例(1.6%)が悪性胚細胞腫瘍の混合型、3例(4.8%)が精巣傍腫瘍であった。最も多い臨床症状(95.2%)は無痛性の陰嚢内腫瘤または腫脹であった。48例は根治的鼠径部精巣摘除術を、15例は精巣温存手術を受けた。59例でフォローアップが可能で、期間は4～128か月(中央値50か月)であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍の1例は術後4か月で再発し、転移に進行した。その他の患者は最終フォローアップ時に無病であった。
結論：思春期前の精巣病変の大半は良性であり、最も多い組織型は奇形腫であった。精巣温存手術の経験は、良性病変にはより侵襲の少ない治療を行うべきという現在の流れを支持する。本研究は、思春期前の精巣腫瘍の小児における良好な治癒率を裏付けるものである。
